pull.title: build: set CMAKE_VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN in REDUCE_EXPORTS
pull.body:
This was originally part of the CMake switchover, but was removed because it was an addition, rather than a port. Add it now.

See https://gcc.gnu.org/onlinedocs/gcc/C_002b_002b-Dialect-Options.html#index-fvisibility-inlines-hidden:

> This switch declares that the user does not attempt to compare pointers
> to inline functions or methods where the addresses of the two functions
> are taken in different shared objects.

> The effect of this is that GCC may, effectively, mark inline methods
> with __attribute__ ((visibility ("hidden"))) so that they do not appear
> in the export table of a DSO

See also https://cmake.org/cmake/help/latest/prop_tgt/VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN.html.

Concept ACK.

The size of `libbitcoinkernel.so` is reduced as expected. For example, on Fedora 44 (GCC 16.1.1, no debug info):
```console
$ ls -l build-master/lib/*.so
-rwxr-xr-x. 1 hebasto hebasto 4820640 Jul 26 09:33 build-master/lib/libbitcoinkernel.so
$ ls -l build-pr35795/lib/*.so
-rwxr-xr-x. 1 hebasto hebasto 4800160 Jul 26 09:47 build-pr35795/lib/libbitcoinkernel.so
```

The most affected section is `.dynstr`:
```console
$ objdump -h build-master/lib/libbitcoinkernel.so | grep \.dynstr
  7 .dynstr       0000882b  0000000000265980  0000000000265980  00265980  2**0
$ objdump -h build-pr35795/lib/libbitcoinkernel.so | grep \.dynstr
  7 .dynstr       0000576c  0000000000264768  0000000000264768  00264768  2**0
```

It seems worth noting in the PR description and/or the commit message that when building for macOS, Clang also applies [`-fvisibility-inlines-hidden-static-local-var`](https://clang.llvm.org/docs/ClangCommandLineReference.html#cmdoption-clang-fvisibility-inlines-hidden-static-local-var).

Tested ACK 3f313a774bec86c09bd8b7151288306ff615e047

Debian 13 / GCC 14.2.0, built parent and tip with `REDUCE_EXPORTS=ON` (and `BUILD_KERNEL_LIB` / `BUILD_SHARED_LIBS`).

```console
$ ls -l build-master/lib/libbitcoinkernel.so build-pr/lib/libbitcoinkernel.so
-rwxr-xr-x 1 henry henry 7058424 build-master/lib/libbitcoinkernel.so
-rwxr-xr-x 1 henry henry 7037944 build-pr/lib/libbitcoinkernel.so

$ nm -D --defined-only build-master/lib/libbitcoinkernel.so | wc -l
378
$ nm -D --defined-only build-pr/lib/libbitcoinkernel.so | wc -l
213
```

The 134 `btck_*` exports are identical; the dropped symbols are libstdc++ inlines. `-fvisibility-inlines-hidden` only appears when `REDUCE_EXPORTS` is on. `test_bitcoin` passed.
